title: Composable Skill Family Replaces Monolithic Build
summary: Decomposes the monolithic build skill into four composable skills sharing a Context Gathering foundation: `/rdd-build` (the outer TDD loop, composing the other three), `/rdd-debug`, `/rdd-refactor`, and the pre-existing `/rdd-review`. Each skill operates in both pipeline mode (full artifact corpus) and context-reconstructive mode (orientation from heterogeneous sources), and can be used standalone or composed within a build cycle.
mechanism: decomposition into four composable skills sharing embedded Context Gathering

links.note: The review skill's demonstrated two-mode pattern and standalone utility (ADR-043 through ADR-047) motivate decomposing build into a similar composable skill family.
Cited alongside ADR-043 as part of the review skill's demonstrated two-mode pattern (ADR-043 through ADR-047) that motivates this decomposition.
The composition trigger semantics proposed here (build invoking inner skills with context inheritance) are new and are extended and specified in detail by ADR-054.
